title: Fixed-G1 into G2 at 125.7598: the corrected class-match retention event (measured, not multiplied), traps counted on joint states (pattern multiplicities withdrawn), report cap with slack, one aux total

claims.statement:
For the fixed nonidentity P in BLS12-381 G1 supplied by the challenge and uniform z in the order-r subgroup of GT (identity included), the disclosed classical algorithm returns Q in G2 with the pinned reduced pairing e(P,Q)=z for that exact supplied P with probability at least 0.39, and its complete classical work is at most 2^125.7598 dense-Fp12-multiplication equivalents at the protected C=20000, summed over all processors with no amortisation; the auxiliary work 2^56.499 is included in that total, not amortised against it (2^125.7598 + 2^56.499 rounds to the same four-decimal log2). The algorithm solves a = log_g z in GT with g = e(P,Q0) on the twelve-element Frobenius classes, N = (r-1)/12 = 2^251.27 classes, ord_r(p) = 12. One step computes the twelve class keys of y: min{keys12(y)} is the sigma-invariant class key used by the DP predicate and table row index, and the index of that minimum is kappa. Then either y is squared with the labels doubled (three of every eight classes) or y is multiplied by the pre-expanded entry TBL[t][col] = sigma^{-col}(M_t) = g^{u_t p^{-col}} with the first label increased by U[t][col] = u_t p^{-col} mod r (five of every eight), col = kappa unless row t occurred among the last D=12 multiply steps, then the recorded column is reused. r-1 is factored exactly in factor_r.py, the product re-multiplied and asserted: r-1 = 2^32*3*11*19*10177*125527*859267*906349^2*2508409*2529403*52437899*254760293^2, 255 bits, twelve distinct prime factors, each prime by Miller-Rabin over twelve bases; ord_r(p) = 12 follows from p^12 = 1 with p^6 != 1 and p^4 != 1; p^6 mod r = r-1 is checked, h = p^6 is not 1 and h^2 = 1, so an order-2 element exists, equals r-1 and is unique in F_r^*; ord_r(2) has 251 bits, so 2^s != 1 throughout the walk.

RETENTION (v15 DEFECT 1). The v15 joint-state predicate is WITHDRAWN: it counted first joint-state meetings (element, ring tuple) anywhere in 1..2D, all at lags 13..24. The event the collision solve consumes is a CLASS match: records with equal class key k solve by x = (p^j a1 - a2)/(b2 - p^j b1), j = 0..11, each candidate VERIFIED against z. The class key depends on the ELEMENT ALONE, so a class match is usable at the report instant and cannot be destroyed by a later guard rewrite. The retention factor on that event is exactly 1 and is NOT carried: the v15 debit 0.9809578 is removed and the budget is set to the same success target 0.392 v15 reached AFTER the debit, so removing it lowers work, not raises the claim. The ring can only destroy path-sharing after a merge, changing the RATE of later matches; measured, not asserted: two trails on the same class with independent rings of equal depth keep identical class keys k steps after the merge at 0.9667 (k=1) and 0.7833 (k=12), R=1024, D=12, versus 0.9750/0.3667 at D=24, 0.9250/0.0417 at D=48 and 0.7833/0.0083 at D=128 (160/120 pairs per depth, CP-95 lower bounds shipped), so shadowing lasts tens of steps against a 2^80-step report interval, below 2^-74 of the walk, inside the 10 per cent allowance. Independent starts match classes at 0.0833 of pairs within 256 steps at R=1024 (20/240): the birthday event the success model counts.

TRAP (v15 DEFECT 2). The v15 pattern union bound is WITHDRAWN, not repaired: enumerating every word of length 4 and 6 over a five-letter alphabet, grouped by row-multiset class, gives an omitted factor 8.9 at L=4 and 74.4 at L=6 (465 times the C(L,L/2)/R^{L/2} charged); multiplicities restore the word space, so no pattern count bounds a cycle. The step is a deterministic function of the augmented state (element, ring tuple), so an absorbing cycle IS an augmented-state repeat, and the union bound over the S step pairs of one walk is tau <= S^2/(2 (r-1) (12R)^D) = 2^-215.26 at R = 2^14, D = 12 (state space 2^465.9), under the ideal-table hypothesis disclosed elsewhere; no pattern enumerated, no theta extrapolated, no 1/(12R) factor multiplied. The bound is 164 bits stronger than v15's withdrawn 2^-50.7, monotone in D (2^-426.3 at D=24, 2^-848.3 at D=48); D=12 is KEPT for best class-stream survival and cheapest guard (48 instructions/multiply step; D=24 costs 84). The class marginal is measured and NOT uniform at fixture scale (chi-square 238889.4 on 526 df, p 0, worst cell 6.57x mean, 527/785 cells; split 27.1/71.8/454.7 at S/sqrt(N) 0.71/1.79/7.14); measured second moment sum_c p_c^2 = 1/N_eff = 0.004708 against 1/N = 0.001274. The v15 sum-of-squares inference is DROPPED: no Poisson bound, no collision-of-collisions step, no credit taken, and the birthday law priced at the smaller pairwise probability 1/N, so measured concentration can only help.

COST. Per-step counted instructions: 21921 multiply step, 13445 squaring step = dense Fp12 multiply 20000 + twelve-key selector 1613 + multiply-channel guard 48 + column address 16 + table fetch 72 + label add 28 + key mix 72 + Granger-Scott cyclotomic squaring 11632 (24 Fp mults, 122 Fp adds). The squaring share is ONE number, routing share f = 3/8, used for the step price, budget S and success model; S is the least integer with S^2(1-f^2) >= 2*mu*N*ln(1/(1-0.392)) at mu = 11/10, giving log2 S = 125.810636; c_raw = 0.937125 and c_stress = 0.965333 with judgement-bounded fold rows repriced at 13/10, giving W_raw = 2^125.716950 and W_stress = 2^125.759734; the claim 125.7598 is the least four-decimal log2 above log2(W_stress) + 2e-5. Success Lambda = S^2(1-f^2)/(2*mu*N) = 0.4975803970, model success 0.3920000, carried with NO retention debit, against the 0.39 floor. Records are 112 bytes (48-byte class key plus two 32-byte exponent limbs) in one shared store. The report count is a CAP with STATED SLACK: mean DP hits = ceil(S/2^80) = 61712849264585, cap = 2 x mean = 123425698529170 records, every per-report row (record write, store lookup, drop-oldest drain) charged AT THE CAP, so the bound holds on every run; the Chernoff row P(hits > cap) <= exp(-mean/3) = 2^-2.97e13 ships beside it; the census calibration (20240 records against cap 512 in 6400/6400 trials, evidence/t4-dp5.json) is not the bound. Peak storage 13823678355071904 bytes (store, labels, U labels, twelve-column advice, guard history, code, scratch). Auxiliary work is GT tower arithmetic, ONE total in ONE file: a GT squaring is the cyclotomic row 11632 instructions = 0.58160 reference units; a 381-bit exponentiation is 381 squarings plus 191 dense multiplies = 412.5896 reference units (v15 printed 411.59 with 190, the MEAN Hamming weight; superseded); charged twice per trail start at the cap, giving 2^56.499 total, 2^-69.26 of W_stress.

EVIDENCE. A real-tower toy with the same guarded step: exhaustive census of all 9420 starts at the shipped D=12 comparing the FULL joint state (element, ring tuple) for 26 steps: joint_min_lag null, zero joint returns, while that run's element ladder has 12 returns at lag 15; depth-0 control returns at lag 2 with 588 element returns and 24 two-cycles; a 256-start 400-step joint window with 156 repeats; a pattern census over every row pattern of length 2..6 at R=8 and R=64 with zero guarded returns in 706500 occurrences at R=64, descriptive only; class-stream sweep over D in {12,24,48,128} at R = 64 and R = 1024 with CP-95 bounds; a measured class-frequency vector with chi-square and per-block split; 768/768 equivariance checks, 0/384 coalescence splits (349/384 control), 256/256 inverse pairs with 32/32 label-bit solves (0/32 sign-flipped control), 144/144 end-to-end solves over all twelve shifts, one verified candidate each, 24/24 checks on BLS12-381 including a real planted pairing instance. The density census (0.7316 at 2^-5, 0.5262 at 2^-7, every collision verified) is fixture-scale only. Success is conditional on three disclosed hypotheses: walk quality within the carried 10 per cent allowance, pseudorandom routing and table fields, ideal coins. No production run, no unconditional success theorem, no novelty claim and no practical break is claimed.
